function.name: history_api_get_president_by_year
function.description: Get the name of the U.S. President for a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The year you want to know the U.S. president of.

full_term_only.description: Flag to determine if we should only return presidents that served a full term for the specified year.

message.content: 在 1940 年，美國的總統是 **富蘭克林·德拉諾‧羅斯福（Franklin Delano Roosevelt）**。他於 1933 年就任，並連續執政至 1945 年去世，在此期間一直擔任該職位。
